'''Troughlyn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal who was imprisoned by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[Belsavis prison]], a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. A gang leader in the prison, Krolak was freed from imprisonment during the [[invasion of Belsavis]] in the [[Galactic War]], and started selling various items to the forces of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in the [[Imperial Lodgement]] in the [[Minimum Security Section]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gang Leader Troughlyn appears as a Social Items Vendor for Imperial players on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
